Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (needs NDA)

Hi Evelyn,

We're wrapping up our vendor security review for Fintech Arc's payments stack and need to review Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covering the most recent audit window. Procurement requires a countersigned NDA before your report can be shared. Can you confirm whether you can provide the report after an NDA is in place, and whether you have a bridge letter available for the audit gap (if the report doesn't cover our requested period)?

Also, please let me know the expected turnaround if we route the NDA through DocuSign today — procurement would like delivery within 48 hours once countersigned.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Security & Risk Manager
Fintech Arc

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (needs NDA)

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for the timeline.

Quick answers:
- Yes, we gate our SOC 2 Type II report behind an NDA for external distribution. Once countersigned we can share the report and related bridge letter (if applicable).
- We typically return the countersigned NDA within business hours; if you send via DocuSign and mark it expedited we can usually complete within ~4 business hours during US business hours.

I've attached our standard mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf). Please send it back via DocuSign and I'll route for countersignature right away. Also confirm the audit period you're targeting (e.g., Jan 1, 2026–Dec 31, 2026) so Karthik can confirm whether we need to issue a bridge letter.

Next steps:
1) Procurement uploads/sends NDA to DocuSign
2) We countersign and provide link to signed copy
3) We share SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge letter via secure share

Evelyn

Evelyn Hart
Director, GTM Security
Redwood Inference
